name: Vinum Locus
notes: 4 printed menu photos, all legible. Photos 1 and 3 are the same 'Felix Hora' happy-hour card photographed on two different visits with some items swapped and prices shifted slightly (e.g. Shishito Peppers $8 both times, Sashimi Lettuce Cups $7 vs $6, Beef Carpaccio $22 vs $21, Sicilian Meatballs $10 vs $9); merged into one list using the later photo's prices for items in both, plus the items unique to each. Photo 2 is the regular Snacks/Seared & Raw menu (higher prices, some overlapping names like Shishito Peppers and Stuffed Dates at different prices - kept separate since it's a different, non-happy-hour list). Photo 4 is a further regular-menu card; its Rosé Aperol Spritz is a drink and was skipped. Charcuterie board (build-your-own, priced per item count, no fixed dish names) was skipped.
